accepted_numerical_oracle.scope: ATH valuation comparisons exclusively; other canonical evidence retains existing exact requirements

checkpoint.commit_rule: update cursor only after target batch commit; restart rechecks source digest and exact existing PK row
checkpoint.source: completed Walkback state and price finalization identity; no invented unfinished checkpoint
checkpoint.source_views: independent bounded read-only transactions; representative historical-case closure, not global cross-database cutover generation

provenance: Every selected field retained exactly. Whole V1 tables, raw source rows in intermediate files and raw provider bodies are not copied. Source schema definitions and row hashes are metadata-only authority.

provider.price_state: accepted finalized historical record remains final; no consumed-budget ledger is reset

resume_authority.authorization: Resume one bounded direct-read representative qualification only; no full V1 copies, production changes, deletion or deployment
resume_authority.prior_attempt: disk gate before any source DB open or generated target file

core_v1.full_file_hash: NOT_READ: source logical authority is schemas plus selected-row hashes; live V1 is not a frozen whole-database generation

ops_v1.full_file_hash: NOT_READ: source logical authority is schemas plus selected-row hashes; live V1 is not a frozen whole-database generation

rollback.procedure: Never activate these representative targets. On failure leave both V1 authorities unchanged and retain partial target plus progress for diagnosis. No source restore/copy/unretire required.

core.transfer_index.ddl:
CREATE TABLE transfer_index (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    signature           TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Transaction signature
    source              TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Source wallet address
    destination         TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Destination wallet address
    amount_lamports     INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- Transfer amount in lamports (avoid floats)
    amount_sol          REAL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (amount_lamports / 1e9) STORED,  -- SOL equivalent
    slot                INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- Slot number (0 when unavailable from feed)
    block_time          INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- Unix timestamp
    indexed_at          REAL NOT NULL,                       -- When indexed (time.time())
    is_valid            BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,          -- Validation flag (for cleanup)
    transfer_type       TEXT DEFAULT 'standard',             -- 'standard', 'spl_token', 'rent', etc.

    -- Composite uniqueness: one row per (tx, sender, recipient) pair
    UNIQUE (signature, source, destination),

    -- Constraints
    CHECK (amount_lamports > 0),
    CHECK (block_time > 0)
)

ON transfer_index(block_time DESC)

ON transfer_index(destination, block_time DESC)

ON transfer_index(source, block_time DESC)

ON transfer_index(is_valid) WHERE is_valid = 1
